briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: A significant number of Medicaid providers in Minnesota are facing removal due to a fraud cleanup effort by the Minnesota DHS. Over 3,400 providers have been notified. Additionally, there have been recent charges filed in $90M Minnesota Medicaid fraud schemes. A $250M fraud scheme has also been reported, with allegations of knowledge by U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar. These cases indicate a large-scale effort to crack down on fraudulent activities within the Medicaid program in Minnesota.
